findings.obs_text: The surface considered carries many codes in two uses. Of attention set on a matter: H7760K with H3820A in Job 1:8 and Job 2:3 (set the heart), H7896K in Pro 24:32, H6437G in Ecc 2:11, H7878 in Isa 53:8, H7200H in Eze 18:28, H7920 in Dan 7:8, G1760 in Mat 1:20, G2657 in Rom 4:19. Of counting as something: H2803H in 1Ki 10:21, 2Ch 9:20 and Neh 13:13, H2803J in Pro 17:28, G1380 in Mar 10:42, G2233 in Heb 11:11 and Heb 11:26, G3049 in Heb 11:19. H0595, H1934 and G3756 are small words in the units.
findings.grounds: Have you considered my servant Job
